text: Two. I think I need some antibiotics, Doctor. Why, what seems to be the problem? I can't stop coughing. I was up most of last night. Have you had a high temperature at all? No, but my head really hurts. I can't really give you antibiotics unless you have some sort of infection. Just rest, take some painkillers and plenty of fluids. I'm sure you'll be fine in a couple of days.
